data.name: RegisterHeading
data.comment: The registration page's heading. "Account" is Glossary vocabulary.

data.name: RegisterIntro
data.value: You get a Space of your own straight away. There is nothing else to decide.
data.comment: Sits under the heading. States what registering gets you, because the whole point of this flow is that no structural decision is asked for. "Space" is Glossary vocabulary.

data.name: DisplayNameLabel
data.comment: Label for the display-name field. Deliberately not "full name" or "real name" - it is whatever this person wants to be called, and it is what their Space is named after.

data.name: DisplayNameHint
data.value: Your Space will be named after this.
data.comment: Help text under the name field, explaining a consequence that is otherwise a surprise.

data.name: EmailAddressLabel
data.comment: Label for the email field.

data.name: PasswordLabel
data.comment: Label for the password field.

data.name: SubmitLabel
data.comment: The submit button. "Account" is Glossary vocabulary.

data.name: SubmitInFlight
data.value: Creating your Account. This takes a few seconds.
data.comment: Shown while the request is in flight, and announced politely. The wait is deliberately long - the password hashing is meant to be slow - so the copy says so plainly rather than leaving a person wondering whether anything happened. Never replace this with a spinner or a progress percentage.

data.name: SubmitComplete
data.value: Your Account is ready, and so is your Space.
data.comment: Announced when registration completes. Deliberately plain - no celebration. Note this is shown whether the address was new or already registered; the two are indistinguishable by design, so this copy must never imply that something was created just now for the first time.

data.name: SubmitFailed
data.value: That could not be sent. Check your connection and try again.
data.comment: Shown when the request never reached the server, or the server answered with something unexpected. It is about the transport, not about the submission.

data.name: SubmitRetry
data.value: That did not go through. Please try again.
data.comment: Shown when the server refused the request's anti-forgery token - which happens for ordinary reasons a person cannot see or act on, such as another tab signing in, or a Session expiring while this form sat open. Pressing the button again fetches a fresh token and works, so this copy asks for exactly that and explains nothing: anti-forgery is not a concept the person has, and naming it would be alarming rather than useful. It must not imply they typed something wrong, and must not imply anything was saved.

data.name: ErrorHeading
data.value: Check the form and try again.
data.comment: Heading of the error region, announced assertively when validation fails. Followed by one line per problem.

data.name: SignInHeading
data.comment: The sign-in page's heading. "Account" is Glossary vocabulary.

data.name: SignInIntro
data.value: One sign-in covers every Space you belong to.
data.comment: Sits under the heading. States the promise the story is about - moving between contexts never asks who you are again. "Space" is Glossary vocabulary.

data.name: SignInSubmitLabel
data.comment: The submit button on the sign-in form.

data.name: SignInInFlight
data.value: Signing you in. This takes a few seconds.
data.comment: Shown while the request is in flight, and announced politely. The wait is deliberately long - checking the password is meant to be slow, and it takes the same time whether or not the address is known - so the copy says so plainly. Never replace this with a spinner or a progress percentage.

data.name: SignInComplete
data.comment: Announced when sign-in completes. Deliberately plain, and it names no Space: no Space is established by signing in, and there is nowhere to go yet.

data.name: SignInFailed
data.comment: THE ONLY MESSAGE FOR A FAILED SIGN-IN, AND IT COVERS EVERY CAUSE. Printed verbatim in the experience spine. It must never become "no account found", "wrong password" or anything else that says which of the two happened - the server answers one problem type with no detail, so this string is the whole of what a person is told, by design. Do not add a second string beside it, and do not add a "create an Account instead?" nudge here.

data.name: SignInToRegisterLink
data.comment: Link to the registration surface, below the sign-in form. It exists because registration would otherwise be reachable only by typing a path. It is NOT a response to a failed sign-in and must never be shown as one - that would say the address is unknown. "Account" is Glossary vocabulary.

data.name: SessionEnded
data.value: Your Session ended. Sign in to continue.
data.comment: Shown when a person is returned here because their Session expired or stopped being valid. It names the Session and NOTHING else - no Space name, no Membership information, and never "you were removed": this is the cold path, where the person is not in a Space and must not be told anything about one. "Session" is Glossary vocabulary and is capitalised in every language, per rule 2 at the top of this file.

data.name: NotAvailable
data.comment: The heading of the refusal page for every not-found, whatever the cause - a Space with no Membership, a Space that does not exist, or an address that matches nothing (UX-DR32, EXPERIENCE.md:131-133). Identical for every cause by design: nothing on the page may distinguish them.

data.name: RefusalRouteBack
data.comment: The one link on the refusal page. It goes to the product's entry point, which lands on the first Space the switcher currently lists - never on a remembered last Space, which may itself be unavailable (EXPERIENCE.md:142, UX-DR32).

data.name: RoleDoesNotPermit
data.value: Your Role in this Space does not permit this.
data.comment: A capability refusal (403) that arrived without a capability code the client knows. Still capability-shaped: it names no object.

data.name: RoleOwner
data.comment: The Role chip for an Owner. Glossary word, sentence case; uppercased by CSS.

data.name: RoleAdmin
data.comment: The Role chip for an Admin. Glossary word, sentence case; uppercased by CSS.

data.name: RoleMember
data.comment: The Role chip for a Member. Glossary word, sentence case; uppercased by CSS.

data.name: RoleViewer
data.comment: The Role chip for a Viewer. Glossary word, sentence case; uppercased by CSS.

data.name: RolePermitsOwner
data.value: can manage everything in this Space, including ownership
data.comment: What an Owner may do, ending the context bar's accessible name. Derived (story 1.7, open question 3): only an Owner may offer ownership or delete the Space.

data.name: RolePermitsAdmin
data.comment: What an Admin may do, ending the context bar's accessible name. Verbatim from the specification (epics.md:826, EXPERIENCE.md:83).

data.name: RolePermitsMember
data.value: can create and edit Projects and Tasks
data.comment: What a Member may do, ending the context bar's accessible name. Derived (story 1.7, open question 3).

data.name: RolePermitsViewer
data.comment: What a Viewer may do, ending the context bar's accessible name. Verbatim from the specification (epics.md:826, EXPERIENCE.md:83).

data.name: ContextBarAccessibleName
data.comment: The context bar's accessible name. {0} is the Space's name, {1} the Role (RoleOwner and its siblings), {2} what the Role permits (RolePermitsOwner and its siblings). Example: "Northwind Redesign — Admin, can manage Members and settings". Keep the order if your language allows it; the em dash may be your language's equivalent separator.

data.name: SpaceSwitchAnnouncement
data.comment: Announced politely after the person switches Space: the destination's name {0}, Role {1} and what it permits {2}. Never names the Space they left (UX-DR38).

data.name: ContextBarShellName
data.comment: The context bar's accessible name when no Space is active - on the refusal page and when the Account belongs to no Space. Names no Space.

data.name: SwitchSpaceLabel
data.comment: The label on the button that opens the Space switcher, after the active Space's name.

data.name: SpaceSwitcherListLabel
data.comment: The accessible name of the switcher's list. Each row in it is a Space's name and nothing else.

data.name: SignOutLabel
data.comment: The button in the context bar that ends the Session - on every device the Account is signed in on, which is how the server ends it.

data.name: AccountSettingsLink
data.comment: The context bar's link to Account settings, after the Space switcher and before Sign out (story 1.8, EXPERIENCE.md:55).

data.name: AccountSettingsHeading
data.comment: The heading of Account settings.

data.name: ApiTokensHeading
data.comment: The heading of the API Token section of Account settings.

data.name: ApiTokenShownOnce
data.value: A Token is shown once, when it is generated. Copy it then: you will not be able to see it again.
data.comment: Said before any Token is generated (story 1.8, AC4; EXPERIENCE.md:274). Must say the Token is shown once and cannot be retrieved. Names no Role.

data.name: ApiTokenNameLabel
data.comment: The label of the Token's name field.

data.name: ApiTokenSpaceLabel
data.comment: The label of the picker choosing the one Space a Token reaches. Its options are the Space switcher's, by name.

data.name: ApiTokenGenerate
data.comment: The button that issues a Token.

data.name: ApiTokenNameInvalid
data.value: Enter a name of 1 to 100 characters.
data.comment: A Token name the Host refused (urn:yello:problem:invalid-api-token).

data.name: ApiTokenShownNow
data.value: This Token is shown once. Copy it now: you will not be able to see it again.
data.comment: Shown above the plaintext, the only time it is shown.

data.name: ApiTokenPlaintextLabel
data.comment: The label of the read-only field holding the plaintext.

data.name: ApiTokenCopy
data.comment: The primary action while the plaintext is shown: copies it to the clipboard.

data.name: ApiTokenCopied
data.comment: Announced once the plaintext is on the clipboard.

data.name: ApiTokenCopyFailed
data.value: Copying did not work. Select the Token and copy it.
data.comment: Announced when the browser refused the clipboard. Focus moves to the field so it can be selected.

data.name: ApiTokenDone
data.comment: Asks to stop showing the plaintext. Never dismisses it on its own: a confirmation follows.

data.name: ApiTokenDismissWarning
data.value: You will not be able to see this Token again.
data.comment: The confirmation before the plaintext is dismissed - the only copy (story 1.8, AC4).

data.name: ApiTokenDismiss
data.comment: Confirms dismissing the plaintext.

data.name: ApiTokenKeepShowing
data.comment: Declines dismissing the plaintext.

data.name: ApiTokenListEmpty
data.comment: The Token list when the Account holds none.

data.name: ApiTokenRevoke
data.comment: Revokes a Token: asks first, then confirms.

data.name: ApiTokenRevokeWarning
data.value: Scripts using this Token will stop working.
data.comment: The confirmation before a Token is revoked.

data.name: ApiTokenCancel
data.comment: Declines revoking a Token.

data.name: SpaceHomeHeading
data.comment: The heading of a Space's home. It does not name the Space - the context bar does. "Project" is Glossary vocabulary.

data.name: ProjectsLoading
data.comment: For assistive technology only, inside the busy region shown while a Space's Project list is on its way (UX-DR35 cold load). Nothing of any Project renders before the answer (UX-DR31).

data.name: ProjectsEmpty
data.comment: A Space with no Projects (AC1, EXPERIENCE.md:252). A valid state, not an error; it asks for nothing but a Project - never for Statuses or configuration.

data.name: ProjectCreate
data.comment: The one action a Space offers to create a Project, empty or not. Absent - not disabled - for a Role that cannot create one (UX-DR27).

data.name: ProjectNameLabel
data.comment: The label of the name field, when creating or renaming a Project.

data.name: ProjectCreateSubmit
data.comment: Submits a new Project's name. Not "Save" (UX-DR26).

data.name: ProjectCreating
data.comment: Shown in place of the create actions while a creation is on its way, so it cannot be sent twice.

data.name: ProjectsLoaded
data.comment: Announced politely when a Space's Project list has arrived and replaced its skeleton (UX-DR35 cold load). Names no Project and no Space.

data.name: ProjectCreated
data.comment: Announced politely once a Project exists. {0} is its name, as the person typed it.

data.name: ProjectRename
data.comment: Both the row's control that opens a rename and the control that commits it. Never "Save": there is no save button anywhere (UX-DR26).

data.name: ProjectRenamed
data.comment: Announced politely once a rename is accepted. {0} is the new name.

data.name: ProjectCancel
data.comment: Closes a create or rename field without sending anything. Esc does the same.

data.name: ProjectNameInvalid
data.value: A Project name is 1 to 100 characters.
data.comment: The invalid-project-name refusal, beside the name field. Never "that name is taken" - Project names need not be unique.

data.name: BoardLoading
data.comment: Visually hidden inside the Board's cold-load skeleton (UX-DR35).

data.name: BoardLoaded
data.comment: Announced politely, once, when the Board has answered (EXPERIENCE.md:390).

data.name: BoardEmpty
data.comment: A Project holding no Tasks (UX-DR35, EXPERIENCE.md:251). No sub-line, and nothing about Statuses or configuration.

data.name: TaskAdd
data.comment: The one primary action on an empty Board, and the accessible name of the first column's create control.

data.name: TaskTitleLabel
data.comment: The label of the inline field a Task is created from.

data.name: TaskAddSubmit
data.comment: Sends the Task in the field. The field stays open, empty, for the next one.

data.name: TaskCancel
data.comment: Closes the Task field without sending anything. Esc does the same.

data.name: TaskAdding
data.comment: Shown while a Task creation is on its way.

data.name: TaskAdded
data.comment: Announced politely after a Task is created.

data.name: TaskTitleInvalid
data.value: A Task title is 1 to 200 characters.
data.comment: The invalid-task-title refusal, beside the title field.

data.name: SkipToContent
data.comment: The first tab stop on every authenticated surface: moves focus past the context bar to the page's heading.

data.name: IdempotencyKeyInFlight
data.value: That was already sent. Reload to see it.
data.comment: 409 idempotency-key-in-flight, inline where a creation or a rename was sent. Never "Not available."

data.name: IdempotencyKeyReused
data.value: That request was already used for something else. Try again.
data.comment: 422 idempotency-key-reused, inline where a creation or a rename was sent. Never "Not available."

data.name: NoSpaceHeading
data.comment: Heading shown to an Account that belongs to no Space. A valid state, not an error (UX-DR35); nothing is created for the person.

data.name: NoSpaceBody
data.value: You do not belong to any Space yet.
data.comment: The sentence under NoSpaceHeading. Story 3.1 (AC15): the state offers one action, CreateSpaceAction, and creates nothing itself (UX-DR35).

data.name: read-projects-and-tasks

data.comment: A capability refusal (403), keyed on the capability code the Host sends. Capability-shaped, never object-shaped (EXPERIENCE.md:104): it names what a Role cannot do, never the thing it was refused on. It names the Roles the matrix denies, so it is true for whoever sees it.

data.name: display-name-required
data.value: Enter the name you want to be called by.

data.name: email-address-too-long
data.value: That email address is too long.

data.name: email-address-malformed
data.value: That does not look like an email address.
data.comment: Deliberately hedged - "does not look like" rather than "is invalid" - because the check is intentionally shallow and should not tell someone their real address is wrong.

data.name: TaskDetailClose
data.comment: The Task detail panel's close control (story 2.3). Esc does the same.

data.name: TaskDetailTitleLabel
data.comment: The Task detail panel's title field label (story 2.3).

data.name: TaskDetailStatusLabel
data.comment: The Task detail panel's Status label, above the picker or the Status as text (story 2.3).

data.name: TaskDetailDueDateLabel
data.comment: The Task detail panel's due date label (story 2.3).

data.name: TaskDueDateClear
data.comment: Removes a Task's due date at once (story 2.3). Never "Save".

data.name: TaskDue
data.comment: A card's due date in its metadata row; {0} is the day and month in the viewer's locale and zone (story 2.3).

data.name: TaskMoved
data.comment: Announced politely, once, when the server has admitted a move or a Status change (story 2.6, AC7, open question 8): {0} is the Status name, {1} the Task's 1-based position in that column as the Board shows it after placing it by the server's key, {2} the column's true total. Never on load, never before the answer.

data.name: DragDropHere
data.comment: Inside the dashed drop zone a pointer or touch drag draws in the destination column, at the slot the dragged Task would land in (story 2.7, UX-DR22; the mockup's words, board.html). Decoration only: hidden from assistive technology, because the polite live region says where a dropped Task went.

data.name: TaskReturned
data.comment: Announced politely when a move or a Status change was refused or got no answer and the card went back to its last admitted slot (story 2.6, AC7, AC15): {0} is the Status name, {1} the 1-based position it returned to.

data.name: TaskPickedUp
data.comment: Announced politely when Space on a focused card picks its Task up with the keyboard (story 2.8, AC10, UX-DR25, open question 5 (a)): {0} is the Task's title, {1} its Status name, {2} its 1-based position in that column, {3} the column's true total. Never the Space or Project name (UX-DR38). The string shape is the dev phase's; UX to confirm (deferred-work.md).

data.name: TaskCarried
data.comment: Announced politely on each step of a keyboard carry (story 2.8, AC10, UX-DR25, open question 5 (a)): {0} is the destination Status name, {1} the 1-based position the Task would take there, {2} the total that column would have with the Task in it - so the end of the column can be heard. UX to confirm (deferred-work.md).

data.name: ColumnCountOne
data.comment: A column's accessible description when its true total is one (story 2.8, AC13, open question 8 (a)): the count chip's bare number is hidden from assistive technology, and this is read instead.

data.name: ColumnCountMany
data.comment: A column's accessible description for any true total but one, zero included (story 2.8, AC13, open question 8 (a)): {0} is the column's true total.

data.name: PagerName
data.comment: The accessible name of the Status pager, the tablist that shows one column at a time below 768px (story 2.11, AC9, open question 4 (a)).

data.name: PagerShown
data.comment: Said politely when the person changes the Status pager's tab (story 2.11, AC4, AC10, open question 4 (a)): {0} is the Status's name and {1} its TRUE total in words (ColumnCountOne or ColumnCountMany), never the number of loaded cards.

data.name: TaskMove
data.comment: The Move control in the Task detail panel and the card menu's item that opens the Move picker (story 2.6, UX-DR21). A plain verb; never "Drag".

data.name: TaskActions
data.comment: Accessible name of a card's actions control and of the menu it opens (story 2.6, open question 6 (a)); {0} is the Task's title.

data.name: TaskMenuOpen
data.comment: The card menu's first item: opens Task detail, as the card's title does (story 2.6, open question 6 (a)).

data.name: MoveStatusStep
data.comment: Accessible name of the Move picker's first step, the list of Statuses (story 2.6, open question 4 (a)).

data.name: MovePositionStep
data.comment: Accessible name of the Move picker's second step, the positions in the chosen Status; {0} is the Status name (story 2.6).

data.name: MoveCurrent
data.comment: Labels the Task's own Status in the Move picker. A label, not a selection: nothing in the picker is selected when it opens (UX-DR11).

data.name: MoveTop
data.comment: The Move picker's first position: before every Task of the chosen Status (story 2.6, open question 4 (a)).

data.name: MovePosition
data.comment: A position in the Move picker (story 2.6, open question 4 (a)): {0} is the 1-based position the Task would take, {1} the title of the Task it would follow.

data.name: MoveBottom
data.comment: Labels the Move picker's last position: after every Task the column shows (story 2.6, open question 4 (a)).

data.name: TaskPositionUnavailable
data.value: That position has changed. Choose it again.
data.comment: 409 task-position-unavailable (story 2.6, open question 3 (a)): the Task chosen as the neighbour has moved or gone. Said where the move was made; the card goes back. Never says why or where the neighbour went.

data.name: TaskPositionFull
data.value: There is no room at that position. Choose another position.
data.comment: 409 task-position-full (story 2.9, AC18, open question 11 (a)): no position key fits after the chosen neighbour, so choosing it again would be refused again. Said where the move was made; the card goes back. Copy to UX for confirmation.

data.name: BoardShowMore
data.comment: The control at the foot of a partly loaded Board column that loads its next page (story 2.9, AC11, open question 5 (a)). No count in it (no nudges). Copy and placement to UX.

data.name: BoardShowMoreName
data.comment: The accessible name of a column's "Show more Tasks" control (story 2.9, open question 5 (a)): {0} is the Status's name. Starts with the visible label.

data.name: MoveMorePositions
data.comment: The Move picker's last option for a partly loaded column (story 2.9, AC11): loads the column's next page and extends the list. Not a position; "Bottom of column" is offered only once the column is fully loaded.

data.name: TaskEditNotSent
data.comment: A write that got no answer. For a Task edit the change is reverted (story 2.3, open question 8). For a Task or Project deletion, said in its confirm or row, nothing is removed and the same press may be sent again (story 2.5). Never "Saved" or "Saving".

data.name: InvalidTaskStatus
data.value: That Status is not one of this Project's Statuses.
data.comment: 400 invalid-task-status, inline in the Task detail panel (story 2.3). Never "Not available."

data.name: InvalidDueDate
data.value: A due date is between 2000 and 2100.
data.comment: 400 invalid-due-date, inline in the Task detail panel (story 2.3). Never "Not available."

data.name: InvalidTaskEdit
data.value: That change could not be read.
data.comment: 400 invalid-task-edit, inline in the Task detail panel (story 2.3). The product's own client never meets it.

data.name: SpaceSettingsLink
data.comment: The link to Space settings in the context bar (story 3.1, AC4, open question 4 (a)), for Owners and Admins only and absent for the others - never on the Role chip; and from an empty Label picker (story 2.4, open question 7).

data.name: SpaceSettingsHeading
data.comment: Space settings' page heading (story 2.4). Never names the Space: the context bar does.

data.name: SpaceSettingsNoLongerAvailable
data.value: You're now a {0}. Space settings is no longer available.
data.comment: Narrated when a Role re-read lower no longer permits Space settings, then said on Space home (UX-DR29). {0} is the Role's name.

data.name: LabelsHeading
data.comment: The Labels section of Space settings (story 2.4).

data.name: LabelsLoading
data.comment: Announced while the Space's Labels are read (story 2.4). Never names a Label.

data.name: LabelsControl
data.comment: The Task detail panel's Labels control, which opens the Label picker, and the Labels attribute's name for a Viewer (story 2.4).

data.name: LabelsEmpty
data.comment: A Space with no Labels, in Space settings and in the Label picker (story 2.4).

data.name: LabelsMore
data.comment: The card's overflow after three Label chips (UX-DR8; story 2.4, open question 5). Text, never a control. {0} is how many more.

data.name: LabelsMoreName
data.comment: The accessible name of the card's '+N' (story 2.4, open question 5). {0} is how many more.

data.name: LabelNameLabel
data.comment: The define form's name field (story 2.4).

data.name: LabelColourLegend
data.comment: The define form's colour radio group (story 2.4, open question 14).

data.name: LabelColourRust
data.comment: Palette colour name: rust. Every swatch is named, so nothing depends on colour (UX-DR7).

data.name: LabelColourOchre
data.comment: Palette colour name: ochre.

data.name: LabelColourOlive
data.comment: Palette colour name: olive.

data.name: LabelColourGrass
data.comment: Palette colour name: grass.

data.name: LabelColourJade
data.comment: Palette colour name: jade.

data.name: LabelColourTeal
data.comment: Palette colour name: teal.

data.name: LabelColourBlue
data.comment: Palette colour name: blue.

data.name: LabelColourOrchid
data.comment: Palette colour name: orchid.

data.name: LabelAdd
data.comment: The define form's one primary action (story 2.4). Never 'Save'.

data.name: LabelAdding
data.comment: While a definition waits for the server, which gives the Label its id (story 2.4).

data.name: LabelAdded
data.comment: Announced politely once a Label is defined (story 2.4, open question 13).

data.name: LabelDeleted
data.comment: Announced politely once a Label is deleted (story 2.4, open question 13).

data.name: LabelDelete
data.comment: A Label's delete control, and the confirmation's danger action (story 2.4).

data.name: LabelCancel
data.comment: Leaves a Label's delete confirmation without deleting.

data.name: LabelNameInvalid
data.value: A Label's name is 1 to 50 characters.
data.comment: 400 invalid-label-name, beside the define form's name field (story 2.4, open question 2).

data.name: InvalidLabelColour
data.comment: 400 invalid-label-colour (story 2.4, open question 3). The product's own form only offers the palette.

data.name: LabelNameTaken
data.value: This Space already has a Label of that name.
data.comment: 409 label-name-taken, beside the name field (story 2.4, open question 2). Never repeats the name.

data.name: LabelInUse
data.value: This Label is on Tasks. Remove it from them first.
data.comment: 409 label-in-use, on the Label's row (AC3; story 2.4, open question 11). No count, no Task names.

data.name: InvalidTaskLabels
data.value: One of those Labels is not in this Space any more.
data.comment: 400 invalid-task-labels, inline in the Task detail panel (story 2.4). Reverts the Labels only.

data.name: DeleteQuestion
data.comment: Opens every in-place delete confirmation - a Task's, a Project's, a Label's (UX-DR12, UX-DR36; story 2.5). {0} is what is deleted, by its own name or title. Never "Are you sure".

data.name: DeleteCannotBeUndone
data.comment: Said by every delete confirmation, after what it destroys (AC4, UX-DR36). The words carry the danger; the border only reinforces them. There is no trash and no restore, so never soften it.

data.name: DeleteCancel
data.comment: Leaves a Task's or a Project's delete confirmation without deleting anything (story 2.5). Esc does the same.

data.name: TaskDelete
data.comment: The Task detail panel's last control, which asks first, and the confirmation's danger action (story 2.5).

data.name: TaskDeleted
data.comment: Announced politely once the server has deleted a Task (story 2.5, open question 11). Never before.

data.name: ProjectDelete
data.comment: A Project row's delete control on Space home, which asks first, and the confirmation's danger action (story 2.5).

data.name: ProjectHoldsNoTasks
data.comment: In the Project's delete confirmation, when it holds no Tasks: the reassurance is the same sentence as the warning (AC2).

data.name: ProjectHoldsOneTask
data.comment: In the Project's delete confirmation, when it holds exactly one Task - deleted with it (AC2).

data.name: ProjectHoldsTasks
data.comment: In the Project's delete confirmation, when it holds more than one Task, all deleted with it (AC2). {0} is the true total, read when the confirmation opened.

data.name: ProjectDeleted
data.comment: Announced politely once the server has deleted a Project (story 2.5, open question 11). Never before.

data.name: ViewToggleName
data.comment: The accessible name of the Board/List view toggle (story 2.10, open question 6 (a)).

data.name: ViewBoard
data.comment: The view toggle's link to the Project's Board (story 2.10).

data.name: ViewList
data.comment: The view toggle's link to the Project's List View (story 2.10).

data.name: ListLoading
data.comment: Visually hidden inside the List View's cold-load skeleton (UX-DR35; story 2.10).

data.name: ListLoaded
data.comment: Announced politely, once, when the List View has answered (UX-DR35; story 2.10, AC19). Paging says nothing.

data.name: ListFilterStatus
data.comment: The legend of the List View's Status filter (story 2.10, open question 4 (a)): any of the checked Statuses.

data.name: ListFilterLabel
data.comment: The legend of the List View's Label filter (story 2.10, open question 4 (a)): any of the checked Labels.

data.name: ListFilterDue
data.comment: The label of the List View's due-date filter (story 2.10, open question 4 (a)).

data.name: ListDueAny
data.comment: The due-date filter's default: every Task, dated or not (story 2.10).

data.name: ListDueNone
data.comment: The due-date filter's choice of Tasks with no due date (story 2.10).

data.name: ListDueRange
data.comment: The due-date filter's choice of a day range in the viewer's zone (story 2.10).

data.name: ListDueFrom
data.comment: The first day of the due-date range, inclusive (story 2.10).

data.name: ListDueTo
data.comment: The last day of the due-date range, inclusive (story 2.10).

data.name: ListSort
data.comment: The label of the List View's sort control (story 2.10). Its accessible name starts with 'Sort'.

data.name: ListSortStatus
data.comment: The sort by the Board's column order (story 2.10, open question 7 (a)); the view's initial order.

data.name: ListSortDueDate
data.comment: The sort by due date, soonest first, Tasks with none last (story 2.10, open question 5 (a)).

data.name: ListSortLabel
data.comment: The sort by the first Label's name, Tasks with none last (story 2.10, open question 3 (a)).

data.name: ListColumnTask
data.comment: The List View's title column header (story 2.10).

data.name: ListColumnStatus
data.comment: The List View's Status column header (story 2.10).

data.name: ListColumnDue
data.comment: The List View's due-date column header (story 2.10).

data.name: ListColumnLabels
data.comment: The List View's Labels column header (story 2.10).

data.name: ListShowing
data.comment: The List View's stated page size under the table (UX-DR19; story 2.10, open question 2 (a)): {0} rows loaded of the true total {1}.

data.name: ListShowMore
data.comment: The control under a partly loaded List View that appends the next page (story 2.10, open question 2 (a)). No count in it.

data.name: ListMatchMany
data.comment: Announced politely once when a filter or sort change settles (story 2.10, AC9): {0} is the true total.

data.name: ListMatchOne
data.comment: Announced politely once when a filter or sort change settles on exactly one Task (story 2.10, AC9).

data.name: ListMatchNone
data.comment: A filter matching nothing: stated alone, with no suggestion and no count (story 2.10, AC8), and announced (AC9).

data.name: ListQueryInvalid
data.value: This list could not be read.
data.comment: The refusal for 400 invalid-list-query (story 2.10, Task 4 (c)). The client only sends queries it built, so this is said, never explained.

data.name: ListCursorInvalid
data.value: The next Tasks could not be loaded.
data.comment: The refusal for 400 invalid-list-cursor (story 2.10, Task 4 (c)): a cursor the server did not issue for the sort.

data.name: CreateSpaceAction
data.comment: Story 3.1 (AC13, AC15, open question 3 (a)): the link at the foot of the Space switcher, outside its list, and the no-Space state's one action. Both open the create page.

data.name: CreateSpaceHeading
data.comment: Story 3.1: the create page's heading. Account-scoped: it names no Space.

data.name: SpaceNameLabel
data.comment: Story 3.1 (AC8, AC16): the label of every Space name input - the create page's and the rename section's. A real label, never a placeholder.

data.name: SpaceNameInvalid
data.value: A Space name is 1 to 200 characters.
data.comment: Story 3.1 (AC9, open question 6 (a)): the invalid-space-name refusal, beside the name field. States the rule; never "that name is taken" - Space names are not unique across Yello (FR-6).

data.name: CreateSpaceSubmit
data.comment: Story 3.1: the create page's primary action.

data.name: CreateSpaceCancel
data.comment: Story 3.1: leaves the create page without sending anything, back to where the person came from.

data.name: SpaceCreating
data.comment: Story 3.1: shown in place of the create actions while a creation is on its way, so it cannot be sent twice.

data.name: SpaceCreated
data.comment: Story 3.1 (AC13, open question 8): announced politely once the Space exists. Names no Space - the arrival's own announcement in the context bar names the new Space and the Role.

data.name: SpaceCreateUnanswered
data.value: The Space may not have been created. Create it again to check; it will not be created twice.
data.comment: Story 3.1 (AC13, open question 2 (a)): the creation got no answer. Sending it again reuses its Idempotency-Key, so the server answers the first attempt rather than creating a second Space.

data.name: SpaceNameHeading
data.comment: Story 3.1 (AC3): the heading of Space settings' name section, shown to Owners and Admins only.

data.name: RenameSpaceAction
data.comment: Story 3.1 (AC3): opens the inline rename form in Space settings. Owners and Admins only; absent, never disabled, for the others (UX-DR27).

data.name: RenameSpaceSubmit
data.comment: Story 3.1: the rename form's primary action.

data.name: RenameSpaceCancel
data.comment: Story 3.1: closes the rename form without sending anything. Esc does the same, and focus returns to Rename.

data.name: SpaceRenaming
data.comment: Story 3.1: shown in place of the rename actions while a rename is on its way.

data.name: SpaceRenamed
data.comment: Story 3.1 (AC14, open question 8): announced politely once the server has renamed the Space. Names no Space; the context bar shows the new name.
